title: Mirrors To The Past
author: GhostladyAtMM
selftext:
I've been very busy writing my new point and click adventure game, Mirrors To The Past. I still have a long way to go but I'll update as I go along.

A mysterious coastal town. A strange old inn. Curious characters and secrets hiding in unexpected places. This classic point-and-click adventure spans two timelines—1980s America and the Prohibition era of the early 1900s. Explore both eras, solve clever puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and discover how the past and present are mysteriously connected.

Filled with exploration, mystery, and a little bit of mischief.

I've used all AI to create the images and am using Adventure Game Studio as the game maker.

Here it is, still rusty but good progress has been made.

[Mirrors To The Past FIrst Scenes](https://youtu.be/wFtdCJkZsF8)

(be sure to watch in HD)

I'll keep you updated as it progresses. 

I will not discuss the hate that comes with creating in AI. If you want to play it, I will be thrilled. If you don't, than you don't.  I'll make one statement...if I didn't use AI for the images, I could not have afforded to create it.  So, I haven't put anyone out of job. I always been an innovative person and I hope others will learn the trade and go into the future and not be a polaroid.
